govdocs-archive_org-Village-Voice-Pike-R: The Village Voice reprint of the Pike Report gives the suppressed 1976 House probe of the CIA. The report leaked to the Voice after the House voted to bury it. Its findings embarrassed the agency. The file is a landmark of intelligence oversight.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-andres-cavo: A 1913 entry on Andrés Cavo — the Mexican Jesuit historian. Adolph Bandelier notes his chronicle. His history told New Spain's tale. The entry preserves his modest fame. A friar among historians. His Tres Siglos told Mexico's story. His pages preserve the colonial tale.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-aquino-sora-a: A 1913 entry on Aquino, Sora, and Pontecorvo — the united diocese of St. Thomas's birthplace. The Angelic Doctor was born at Roccasecca. The Liri valley keeps his memory. The see guards the saint's cradle. A diocese of the Ciociaria. Its cathedral keeps the saint's relics.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-belgrade-and-: This 1913 reference piece on Belgrade and Smederevo — the Serbian archdiocese. Albert Battandier gives its border story. Its bishops serve the Danube flock. The fortress guards the river town. A see of the Balkan frontier. Its cathedral crowns the Sava's bank.
